title: Staging Recovery Phase B certification transport, authority, and diagnostics closure

phases.objective: Close the repository-side gap between genuine local Staging Recovery canary evidence and independently countersigned certification, while also restoring the bounded read authority and safe diagnostics needed to identify live Phase B blockers without synthesizing evidence, widening execution authority, or enabling Production mutation.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A real local Phase B canary bundle bound to exact main is transported without secrets to GitHub, independently re-verifies the Kernel artifacts and exact-SHA negative suites, and produces a Production-consumable signed certification record that can be independently published back to Staging readiness.
steps: Require local main to equal exact origin/main before canary execution.
Require real registration, OAuth, network-isolation, Worker provenance, and ingress-build JSON evidence instead of synthesizing external claims.
Execute the genuine Staging-only Recovery Kernel canary and persist the complete plan, approval, ticket, run, receipt, lifecycle, target, and server-identity bindings.
Transport only the bounded no-secret evidence bundle to the manual exact-main GitHub countersign workflow.
Run exact-SHA negative regression suites in the countersign job and bind their pass evidence to GITHUB_SHA.
Emit a canonical staging certification with complete lifecycle trace, negative tests, server identity fingerprint, artifact integrity, freshness, and canonical payload hash.
Download the successful countersign artifact on Staging, verify it again against dedicated public trust, and publish it immutably to the local readiness evidence store.
assertions: The six external-evidence checks remain evidence-driven and are never converted to true by repository defaults.
The countersign workflow checks out and verifies the same exact main SHA as the local canary.
A missing, failing, or cross-SHA negative-test envelope blocks certification.
No approval token, credential, raw SQL, provider secret, or Production mutation authority is included in the transported bundle.
Production live activation remains false during Staging canary, countersign, and publication.
A merged repository change is only a prerequisite; live evidence collection and countersign publication must run again on the post-merge exact main SHA.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Cloudflare 520-527 origin failures such as HTTP 522 are classified as retryable platform-origin outages instead of opaque generic HTTP errors.
steps: Parse the platform HTTP status exactly once.
Preserve bounded automatic polling retry and a diagnostic that identifies Cloudflare origin-side failure.
assertions: HTTP 522 is retryable and not treated as an unknown Local Manager defect.
No credential or token material is added to diagnostics.

e2e_journeys.actor: Admin GPT through the governed Staging Recovery transport
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Activation Gateway and Staging runtime catalog
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Staging can distinguish missing read authority, read-only recovery snapshots, empty SQL device projection, trusted-ingress verification failures, Gateway signing failures, and GitHub App installation resolution without weakening fail-closed recovery rules or accepting caller-selected repository authority.
steps: Grant the Staging runtime role SELECT-only authority to execution_policies while keeping Production bootstrap grants unchanged.
Expose the Device Tools catalog source, dispatch availability, and a bounded empty-projection or read-only-snapshot reason code.
Preserve RECOVERY_TRUSTED_INGRESS_REQUIRED while returning the verifier's safe reason code without secret material.
Classify missing Gateway ingress authority and invalid signing keys as explicit 503 conditions rather than generic upstream 502 failures.
Resolve a missing GitHub App installation id from the server-owned activation bootstrap repository binding before token-cache lookup.
Defer any Device Tool reconciliation migration until live SQL readback specifically proves device_tool_projection_empty.
assertions: execution_policies receives SELECT and never UPDATE through the Staging runtime grant overlay.
No connected_systems row count is treated as the causal source of Device Tools projection state.
Trusted ingress remains mandatory and no local_connector or connector_ps fallback is introduced.
Gateway signing diagnostics never return JWK, signing key, approval token, or other credential material.
GitHub repository owner/repo used for installation discovery comes from server-owned activation bootstrap authority, not request input.
No live grant, migration, provider call, deployment, restart, or Production mutation is performed by this repository change.
